Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
I've been told that a concealed weapon's cost cannot be reduced by
Baldesar's special. I would like to understand why :

Baldesar Rosselini :

Independent: Once each turn, if Baldesar is ready, he can reduce the cost of
a location or of an equipment you play by 1 pool or blood. +1 strength.

Concealed Weapon :

Equip this minion with a non-unique weapon card from your hand at the
beginning of a round. Pay weapon's equip cost, as normal. The weapon cannot
cost more than 2 pool or inflict (with a regular strike) aggravated damage
or more than 3 damage.

T.I.A.
------------
Orpheus, proud son of "Don" Antonino Cirri [07/02/1923 - 29/01/2005]
